overview: A Slack-style office management web app with passwordless auth, company groups/channels, integrated chat and task management, and role-based dashboards. Black and white Material 3 design.
features: Slack-style sidebar with nested group channels
Integrated chat and task management per group
KPI cards and reporting with task progress analytics
Mobile-first responsive design with bottom navigation
Material 3 design with black and white palette
Skeleton loaders, toast notifications, and smooth animations
